classification: measurement correction after U01-OFF applicability analysis
issue: The initial OFF applicability analyzer marked production_search_reachable=true when a function-call output could be linked to a producing rg/grep command. This was sufficient to establish search provenance but was not sufficient to establish execution of the downstream relevance-split path.

production_architecture.provider_gate: OpenAI Responses accepts either structural search recognition or a producing bash-search call_id and may build trajectory context.
production_architecture.router_gate: ContentRouter only changes relevance_strategy to SEARCH from trajectory metadata when the lossless structural pass reports lossless_search; otherwise relevance split requires the existing primary strategy to already be LOG or SEARCH.
production_architecture.preservation_floor: Adopted identifiers affect retention only inside _relevance_split_compress via force_keep_identifiers.

impact: The original analyzer overstated full production-path applicability. No production code or frozen algorithm was changed. The correction changes interpretation, not recorded agent output.
selection_outcome: U01 was nevertheless already consumed as the locked ON task and is not replaced.
